recommendation_summary: Set up a hosted healthchecks.io dead man's switch that `nightly-sync` pings when it finishes, so the user gets an email alert if no ping arrives by about 04:00.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know within a day when `nightly-sync` doesn't succeed, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: The central Synology log and the move to Docker. You won't read logs, a log can't report a run that never happened, and nothing needs to move off `edna`.
labels.Bottleneck: Failure is silent. The only signal is the success email, so a crash means no message at all.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you told me: one cron job at 03:00 on `edna`, four startup crashes from an expired token before the email step, and no other alerting. I haven't looked at the script or crontab yet.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert and explicitly drops the Synology log and Docker setup.
